issue.title: Crash when using `match` on object typed by `TypeVar` with constraints
issue.body:
**Crash Report**

`mypy` crashes when run on a file with a function definition using a `TypeVar` with constraints when `match` is used on an object typed by that `TypeVar`.

This might be related to issue #12448 (Crash on match statement in generic class with restricted type variable), but since the traceback is different, I've created a fresh issue.

**Traceback**

```
$ mypy --show-traceback example.py
example.py:6: error: INTERNAL ERROR -- Please try using mypy master on Github:
https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/common_issues.html#using-a-development-mypy-build
Please report a bug at https://github.com/python/mypy/issues
version: 0.942
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 424, in accept
  File "mypy/nodes.py", line 739, in accept
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 775, in visit_func_def
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 779, in _visit_func_def
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 841, in check_func_item
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 861, in check_func_def
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 1470, in expand_typevars
  File "mypy/checker.py", line 5997, in expand_func
  File "mypy/nodes.py", line 739, in accept
  File "mypy/treetransform.py", line 115, in visit_func_def
  File "mypy/treetransform.py", line 572, in block
  File "mypy/treetransform.py", line 194, in visit_block
  File "mypy/treetransform.py", line 583, in statements
  File "mypy/treetransform.py", line 556, in stmt
TypeError: mypy.nodes.Node object expected; got None
example.py:6: : note: use --pdb to drop into pdb
```

**To Reproduce**

The following simple Python script produces the crash when `mypy` is run on it:

```python
from typing import TypeVar

T = TypeVar("T", int, str)


def add_ten(x: T) -> T:
    match x:
        case int():
            return x + 10
        case str():
            return x + " ten"
```

This was tested on a clean environment with only `mypy` installed.

**Your Environment**

I've reproduced the error on a clean Python 3.10.3 environment without any config files. Only change to vanilla Python was: `pip install mypy`.

- Mypy version used: `0.942`
- Mypy command-line flags: `--show-traceback`
- Mypy configuration options from `mypy.ini` (and other config files): `None`
- Python version used: `3.10.3`
- Operating system and version: `macOS Monterrey 12.3.1`

```python
from typing import List, TypeVar

T = TypeVar("T", int, str)  # Doesn't crash when T = TypeVar("T")

def get_value(xs: List[T]) -> None:
    x = 12
    match x:
        case _:
            pass
```
